exceptions.reason: GSAP core is the owner-approved editorial motion library for the Home page (DEC-029). It is not MIT: GreenSock's Standard No Charge licence permits commercial use; the restrictions (no use in tools competing with visual animation builders, no redistribution of modified copies as a competing library) do not apply to this site.
exceptions.mitigation: Pinned exact version, no install script, no dependencies. Imported only from src/components/ui/motion/gsap/** (ESLint no-restricted-imports plus dependency-cruiser rule); lazy chunk only, never in First Load JS. CSS Reveal remains the fallback if the exception is not renewed.
